title: Probable but Not Valid: A Psychometric Audit of Decision Models as Synthetic Survey Respondents
abstract: arXiv:2610.14912v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models are increasingly used to create synthetic survey samples, also called silicon samples. Decision models are a new class of language models that return a probability for each point of a rating scale instead of text. We ask whether these models, or the newest generative LLMs, can stand in for human respondents on a psychometric survey. We test fourteen decision models from eleven providers and 47 generative LLMs on an open Lithuanian organisational-psychology survey (n=263, 68 items), with 100 real respondent profiles, the Psychometric Similarity Score (PSS) and statistical baselines. The best generative model, MiniMax M3, reaches PSS 0.813. This is level with a Gaussian copula fit only on other respondents (0.824) and below a copula fit in sample (0.927). translated_title: 或然但非有效：决策模型作为合成调查受访者的心理测量学审计
translated_abstract: 语言模型正越来越多地被用于创建合成调查样本，也称为“硅基样本”。决策模型是一类新型的语言模型，它针对量表上的每个评分点返回概率值而非文本。我们探究这些模型或最新的生成式大语言模型能否在心理测量调查中替代人类受访者。我们在一项公开的立陶宛组织心理学调查（n=263，68个题项）上，借助100份真实受访者画像、心理测量相似度分数（PSS）以及统计基线，测试了来自11家提供商的14个决策模型和47个生成式大语言模型。表现最好的生成式模型MiniMax M3达到PSS 0.813，与仅基于其他受访者拟合的高斯copula模型（0.824）相当，但低于样本内拟合的copula模型（0.927）。另一个由100名真实个体组成的样本得分低于最佳模型，因此在该样本规模下PSS无法将其与真实受访者进行区分排名。在10个产品线中的5个，最新的生成式……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究对决策模型与最新生成式大语言模型作为心理测量调查中人类受访者替代品的可行性进行了系统审计，发现其回答相似度虽可比肩统计基线，但尚不足以真实有效地替代人类受访者。
en_tdlr: This psychometric audit systematically evaluates decision models and the latest generative LLMs as substitutes for human survey respondents, finding that although their response similarity rivals statistical baselines, they still cannot validly replace human respondents in psychometric surveys.
